description: This file defines the absl::MockingBitGen class, a mock implementation of a Uniform Random Bit Generator (URBG) for testing purposes within the Google Test framework. It provides mechanisms to mock random distributions and their calls, enabling deterministic testing of code that relies on randomness.

classes.name: MockingBitGen
classes.description: A mock class implementing a Uniform Random Bit Generator (URBG) interface for testing, allowing deterministic control over random distributions within the Google Test framework.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns a pseudo-random result by invoking the internal generator.

methods.name: RegisterMock
methods.description: Registers a mock function for a specific distribution signature, enabling controlled mock behavior during tests.

methods.name: InvokeMock
methods.description: Invokes a registered mock function for a given distribution type, returning false if no mock is registered.
